final: WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.date BETWEEN '960509' AND '980106' GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_regional_amount FROM regional) SELECT r.region, r.avg_signed_amount, r.transaction_count, r.avg_signed_amount / o.avg_regional_amount AS ratio FROM regional AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_regional_amount IS NOT NULL
